tenders.title: Procurement of 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System for Indian Army
tenders.tendering_authority: Ministry of Defence / Department of Military Affairs, Indian Army
tenders.scope_summary: This tender is for the procurement of one unit of a 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System as per MHA QRs (Q3) for the Indian Army. The system is essential for enhancing the operational capabilities of the Indian Army.
key_points: Procurement of one 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System.
Issued by the Department of Military Affairs, Ministry of Defence.
Bidding process started on 2026-09-18 at 8:11 PM and closes on 2026-09-22 at 9:00 PM.

tenders.title: Procurement of 3D Mechanical CAD Software Solution
tenders.tendering_authority: Andrew Yule And Company Limited (Ministry of Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises)
tenders.scope_summary: This tender is for the procurement of a 3D Mechanical CAD Software Solution, with a total quantity of one unit required, as detailed in the attached specification sheet.
key_points: Procurement of one unit of 3D Mechanical CAD Software.
Issued by Andrew Yule And Company Limited, Department of Heavy Industry.
Bidding process commenced on 2026-08-31 at 3:58 PM and concluded on 2026-09-21 at 4:00 PM.
